name: Inkling
description: Thinking Machines' flagship open-weights Mixture-of-Experts multimodal model, supporting Native MoE transformer architecture and up to 1M token context window.
keyFeatures: Native MoE architecture with 975B total parameters and 41B active parameters
Pretrained on 45 trillion tokens including text, images, audio, and video
Support for 1 million tokens context window at full inference
curatorNotes: First open-weights model from Thinking Machines. Features a massive 975B MoE structure with sparse active routing.
